description: Fix z-index stacking context conflicts between the floating navbar (z-index from --z-sticky: 1000) and modal overlays (z-40 = 40 and z-50 = 50). The Modal uses z-40 for its overlay container and z-50 for the dialog panel, but the floating navbar CSS uses --z-sticky (1000). This means the navbar renders ON TOP of modals, blocking interaction. Also fix the TournamentComplete component which uses w-screen causing horizontal scrollbar overflow on mobile.
steps: 1. In src/shared/components/layout/Modal.tsx, change the outer container from 'z-40' to 'z-[9998]' and the inner dialog panel from 'z-50' to 'z-[9999]'. This ensures the modal renders above the floating navbar (z-index: 1000 from --z-sticky). The values 9998/9999 are deliberately below the --z-max (10000) used for the boot screen only.

2. In src/features/tournament/components/TournamentComplete.tsx, the outer div uses 'w-screen' combined with 'style={{ marginInline: "calc((100% - 100vw) / 2)" }}'. The w-screen utility (100vw) does NOT account for scrollbar width and causes horizontal overflow on desktop browsers with visible scrollbars. Replace 'w-screen' with 'w-full' and remove the marginInline style since the component already renders within a full-width flex container.
3. In src/shared/components/layout/Lightbox.tsx, confirm its z-50 (currently) is also below the navbar. Change to z-[9998] to match the modal pattern so lightbox images appear above the navbar.
acceptance_criteria: Modal z-index values are above 1000 (the navbar z-index) so modals appear over the navbar
Lightbox z-index is above 1000 so it appears over the navbar
TournamentComplete no longer uses w-screen, preventing horizontal scroll overflow
pnpm run test passes (same as before)
